answer: An agent economy can resist sybil attacks with unique-work puzzles tied to real output. Before each transaction the network derives a challenge from the payload it posts, so a precomputed farm cannot answer for dozens of fake agents. Spammers must burn compute on every shell. Like a caravan crossing a dune where only real travelers leave tracks, or water carving passages through karst limestone, each solution is auditable. When every proof carries a cipher only the true worker could produce, faking presence costs more than honest work and sybil clusters collapse.
